_meta.description: Shadowblade subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: crit burst, armor pierce, evasion.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les degats critiques de 1% et la penetration d'armure de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases crit damage by 1% and armor penetration by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente l'esquive de 1% et la vitesse d'attaque de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases evasion by 1% and attack speed by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente l'ATK de 0.8% et la chance de critique de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases ATK by 0.8% and crit chance by 0.5% per level.
